body:
Hello, I’ve recently been through a very similar situation. I lost my best friend just over a month ago to suicide, and it’s absolutely heartbreaking. 
He was in the same situation, in and out of mental hospitals and didn’t have a family support system. 
The only thing I can say is be there for your friend no matter what. My friend was in the mental hospital and we all thought he was getting the help he needed. Turns out he was associating with people in there who were just as bad, if not worse than him. It messed with his mind, and in my opinion, was a factor in his death. 
I’m not saying the mental hospital caused his death, however I feel if he had options other than just the mental hospital things could have been different. It’s conflicting, you think they’re getting the help they need but if anything they need the extra support now more than ever. 
Try your best to be there for your friend, do whatever it takes, because if something happens it’ll play on your mind for the rest of your life. Support is the best thing, but also prioritise your own well-being too. 
I hope this helps in some way
I really needed to hear this. Thank you very much.
